# Clear working days; two-day postal service · 1 of 3

[Decision profiles](../README.md) · [Method and other cases](README.md) · [Clerk procedure](../../../handbook/governance/notice-control.md)

**Given.** Meeting and service use the same local dates. Monday–Friday working days; 17 June, 1 July and 10 August 2026 are fixture holidays. Dispatch and service must be on a working day. Effective service is two qualifying days after dispatch.
